name: Dimensional Sword
summary: The basic equipment: one Flux, one Power and Surge — and from Retire it comes back by paying for it.

face.name: Dimensional Sword

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: The Entity it is assigned to has +1 Power and Surge. You may assign this Object from your Retire Zone by paying its Flux cost.

face.flavor: It cuts where the world is already thin.
